findings.citation: It must include entries for `transcription_location`, `asr_engine`, `eliminated`, `code_switch_error_pct`, `arm64_code_switch_error_pct`, `in_person_diarization`, `telehealth_diarization`, `capture_format` and `stack_footprint_mb`; each list must contain every source the answer depends on.
findings.description: The citation checks enforce only subsets, so they do not verify every dependency. In particular, the oracle identifies S4 and S7 as dependencies of `transcription_location`, S1 as a dependency of `eliminated`, and S1 and S5 as dependencies of `telehealth_diarization`, but the corresponding checks omit those source IDs.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
